subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
title: Attributes of God
overview: An attribute is a quality that shows what someone is like. In this sub-strand you will read 1 John 4:7-8, Genesis 1:1-25 and 1 Samuel 2:2, and name God as Sole Creator, Loving Father and Holy Father. You will learn that this loving Father knows you by your name.

lessons.title: Three attributes of God
objectives: Read scriptures on the attributes of God.
List three attributes of God: Sole Creator, Loving Father and Holy Father.
lessons.intro: You can describe a friend as kind or brave. Those words are qualities. The Bible also gives qualities of God. They are called His attributes. Knowing them helps you worship Him as He truly is.
lessons.notes:
An attribute of God is something that is always true about Him. People can change. God does not stop being who He is. In this sub-strand we learn three attributes: Sole Creator, Loving Father and Holy Father.

### Sole Creator: Genesis 1:1-25
Genesis 1:1 says that in the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. Verses 1 to 25 tell how He made light, the sky, the dry land and the seas, plants, the sun, the moon and the stars, fish and birds, and the animals on the land. He did this by His word. No other god made the world. Sole Creator means He alone is the Maker. When you see a river, a tree or the night sky, you are looking at His work.

### Loving Father: 1 John 4:7-8
1 John 4:7-8 tells believers to love one another, because love comes from God. The passage says that God is love. A person who does not love does not know God. Love is not a mood God sometimes has. Love is what He is. He is a Father who loves.

### Holy Father: 1 Samuel 2:2
In 1 Samuel 2:2 Hannah prays, "There is no one holy like the LORD." Holy means pure, set apart, and completely good. There is no evil in God. He is also called a Rock, strong and safe. Because He is holy, we revere Him. Revere means to honour Him with deep respect, in the way we speak, pray and obey.

### Sorting the words
You can sort letters and join words from a puzzle: sole creator, loving, holy. Say them aloud. These three attributes belong together. The Creator is not far away and uncaring. He is the holy God, and He is love.

keyWords.meaning: a quality that shows what someone is like
pure, set apart, and completely good

activity.title: Picture-read the three passages
steps: In groups, picture-read 1 John 4:7-8, Genesis 1:1-25 and 1 Samuel 2:2 in turns.
Sort and match letters to spell Sole Creator, Loving Father and Holy Father.
Join the words sole creator, loving and holy from a puzzle.
Each group tells the class which verse matches which attribute.

practice.question: What is an attribute of God?
practice.answer: A quality that is true about God, such as holy or loving.

practice.question: Which passage shows that God is the Sole Creator?
List the three attributes of God in this sub-strand.
practice.answer: Sole Creator, Loving Father and Holy Father.

practice.question: Which verse says there is no one holy like the LORD?

summary: Genesis 1:1-25 shows God as the Sole Creator.
1 Samuel 2:2 says there is no one holy like the LORD.

lessons.title: God our loving Father knows our names
objectives: Recognise God as a loving Father who knows each learner by name.
Compose a short poem on "God our loving Father."
lessons.intro: A good father knows the names of his children. He does not call them "that one" and walk past. The Bible teaches that God is a Father like that, only greater, because He is holy and He is love.
lessons.notes:
A loving father provides, protects, corrects and listens. God does all of this perfectly. He is not loving one day and cruel the next. 1 John 4:8 says God is love, so His care does not run out.

### He knows you by name
You learnt to say your own name so that people can identify you. God already knows that name. He knew you when He formed you. When Jesus called Zacchaeus, He used his name. The same God knows your name in this class. You are not hidden in a crowd. You can pray, "Father, You know me," and you are telling the truth.

Knowing your name also means He knows your joys and your troubles. You can tell Him when you are afraid. A loving Father wants His children to speak to Him.

### How we respond
- Call Him Father when you pray.
- Obey Him because you love Him, not only because you fear punishment.
- Love other people, since love comes from God.
- Revere Him. Do not use His name as a joke.
- Thank Him for creating you and for daily care.

### A poem and a song
Compose a short poem that begins, "God our loving Father." You might write about Him making the world, loving you, and knowing your name. Read it to the group. Then sing a song about the love of God. Working and singing together builds unity.

Why should you know God's attributes? Because you worship what you know. If you know He is the only Creator, you will not trust another god. If you know He is holy, you will hate sin. If you know He is a loving Father, you will come to Him with your real name and your real needs.

keyWords.meaning: God, who cares for His children perfectly because He is love
to honour God with deep respect

examples.problem: A learner says, "God is too busy to know a child in Grade 4." How do the attributes of God answer her?
steps: God is the Sole Creator, so the whole world is His work, including her.
God is love, so He is not too busy to care.
As a loving Father He knows His children by name.
examples.answer: God is not too busy. He is the Creator and a loving Father who knows her by name.

activity.title: Poem: God our loving Father
steps: In groups, talk about how a loving father treats his children, and how God is greater.
Each learner composes a short poem on "God our loving Father," including the idea that He knows us by name.
Sing a song about the love of God.

practice.question: What does it mean that God knows you by your name?
practice.answer: He knows who I am personally and cares for me as His child. I am not lost in a crowd.

practice.question: Which attribute tells us that God's care does not run out?
practice.answer: Loving Father, because God is love.

practice.question: Give one way to respond to God as a loving Father.
practice.answer: Any one: pray to Him as Father, obey Him, love other people, revere His name, thank Him.

summary: God is a loving Father, and love is what He is.
He knows each child by name.
We respond by praying, obeying, loving others and revering Him.

quiz.question: An attribute of God is...
options: a story we invent about Him
a quality that is true about Him
quiz.explanation: Attributes are God's qualities, such as holy and loving.

quiz.question: Which passage do we read to see God as Sole Creator?
quiz.explanation: Genesis 1:1-25 tells how God alone made the world.

quiz.question: 1 John 4:8 says that God is...
quiz.explanation: The verse says God is love.

quiz.question: "There is no one holy like the LORD" comes from:
quiz.explanation: Hannah's prayer in 1 Samuel 2:2 speaks of God's holiness.

quiz.question: Which three attributes belong to this sub-strand?
quiz.answer: Sole Creator, Loving Father and Holy Father.
quiz.explanation: These are the three attributes learners sort, match and puzzle out.

quiz.question: Sole Creator means...
options: God made the world together with many gods
God alone made the heavens and the earth
quiz.explanation: Sole means the only one. Genesis 1 shows God creating by His word.

quiz.question: To revere God means...
options: to honour Him with deep respect
to use His name as a joke
to fear Him and run away forever
quiz.explanation: Reverence is deep respect shown in worship and obedience.

quiz.question: How is God a loving Father to you?
quiz.answer: He cares, provides, protects and knows me by my name.
quiz.explanation: A loving father knows his children. God does this perfectly.

quiz.question: A learner says God is too busy to know her name. The best answer is:
options: She is right because Grade 4 is small
God knows her by name because He is a loving Father
Only adults are known by God
Names do not matter to the Creator
quiz.explanation: God the loving Father knows each person personally.

quiz.question: Why should you know the attributes of God?
quiz.answer: So that you worship Him as He truly is: the only Creator, holy, and love.
quiz.explanation: Knowing who God is guides reverence and trust.
